newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar prices in modest gains on fresh demand.
newsitem.headline: India sugar prices in modest gains on fresh demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Monday saw modest gains on fresh consumer demand as well as renewed interest, dealers said.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by five rupees at 1,420/1,460 rupees per quintal while sugar M-30 looked up by same margin at 1,465/1,490 rupees per quintal. Fresh arrivals from mills to the market also remained slow amidst delays in the allocation of state-wise quantity of sugar out of the free sale quota announced for June.
The free sale quota for June is 800,000 tonnes unchanged from last month. Quota for April was 7,50,000 tonnes.
Sugar mill delivery slid by 10 rupees at 1,350/1,360 rupees per quintal amid sluggish outstation buying at the mill level.
